title: Memory startup pitches space-efficient GCRAM as SRAM drop-in
supports: RAAAM 3T gain-cell GCRAM pitched as SRAM drop-in with background refresh; company claims up to ~50% area and multi-x power savings vs SRAM (via search snippet)

title: GlobalFoundries and RAAAM: next-generation GCRAM technology and test chip on the FDX platform
supports: GF-RAAAM strategic collaboration to develop and qualify GCRAM; GCRAM test vehicle taped out on GF FDX (FD-SOI); design access for lead customers early 2027; projected ~40% memory area shrink and up to 60% memory power reduction vs SRAM (via search snippet)

title: GlobalFoundries, RAAAM develop next-gen GCRAM on FDX platform
supports: Same GF-RAAAM FDX GCRAM announcement (via search snippet)

title: RAAAM aims to extend Moore's Law to memory: moving toward 2nm qualification at TSMC
supports: RAAAM moving toward 2nm qualification at TSMC; search summary of the RAAAM result set reports a $17.5M Series A led by NXP and GCRAM demonstrated across foundry nodes from 180nm to 5nm FinFET (via search snippet; WebFetch failed DNS, exact page carrying each figure not confirmed)

title: RAAAM Memory Technologies: $4 Million Raised
supports: RAAAM earlier $4M raise for on-chip memory (via search snippet)

title: Startups Stage 2026: RAAAM
supports: RAAAM presenting at SEMICON Taiwan 2026 startup stage: company active in 2026 (via search snippet)

title: IonQ Completes Acquisition of SkyWater Technology
supports: IonQ completed acquisition of SkyWater 2026-07-31 ($15.00 cash + 0.4883 IONQ shares per share); SkyWater continues as a wholly owned subsidiary serving foundry customers; MN, FL, TX sites remain active (via search snippet)

title: IonQ completes acquisition of SkyWater Technology
supports: Same close; SkyWater CEO: fully committed to all semiconductor foundry customers (via search snippet)

title: SkyWater Technology Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Fiscal Year 2025 Results
supports: FY2025 record revenue $442.1M driven primarily by Fab 25 acquisition; no earnings webcast due to pending IonQ acquisition (via search snippet)

title: Cadence and SkyWater Detail Next Open Multi-Project Wafer Shuttle Program
supports: Cadence/SkyWater SKY130 open MPW: design submissions through 2026-01-16, die delivery targeted July 2026 (~6-month fab turn) (via search snippet)

title: Efabless Launches chipIgnite with SkyWater to Bring Chip Creation to the Masses
supports: 2021 chipIgnite: 10 mm2 per project on SKY130, $9,750 incl. 100 packaged parts and 5 eval boards (via search snippet; 2021 price, current pricing unverified)

title: Caravel lecture slides (COMP.CE.250, spring 2026)
supports: Umbralogic Technologies LLC dba ChipFoundry acquired Efabless assets; Efabless shut down for financial reasons in 2025; ChipFoundry continues MPW shuttle programs with Caravel, Caravan, OpenFrame (via search snippet; secondary source)

title: SkyWater Completes Acquisition of Fab 25
supports: Fab 25 closed 2025-06-30; ~400,000 wafer starts/yr; ~1,000 employees joined; 65-130nm; targets embedded processors/MCUs, memory, mixed-signal, RF, power (via search snippet)

title: SKYT Fab 25 announcement presentation
supports: Fab 25 adds 65nm infrastructure, expanded copper, HV BCD; eNVM listed among capabilities; $110M headline price incl. $25M wafer credits (via search snippet)

title: Renesas SRAM EOL 2026
supports: Renesas EOL notice EOL260016 (2026-06-01) discontinues 92 asynchronous SRAM orderable codes, mapping some to Infineon codes (via search snippet; notice itself not opened)

title: SRAM (Static RAM)
supports: Infineon still markets async SRAM ('broadest portfolio of Asynchronous SRAMs from 256K to 64M') and QDR SRAM; no 2025-26 Infineon SRAM EOL notice found (via search snippet)

title: US7630235B2 Memory cells, memory devices and integrated circuits incorporating the same
supports: TRAM (TCCT + NMOS access) and access-transistor-free TCCT-DRAM cells; notes TCCT-DRAM suffers disturbance such as charge loss during write-zero (via search snippet)

title: US6778435B1 Memory architecture for TCCT-based memory cells
supports: TCCT memory architecture patent: thyristor-based cell produces a bit-line current (via search snippet)

title: OpenRAM SkyWater 130nm test chips (NSF PAR)
supports: First OpenRAM silicon in SkyWater 130nm verified: 32-bit 1-kilobyte dual-port (1RW+1R) SRAM; IO-pad limited test; second test chip MPW2 with open-source DRC/LVS (via search snippet)

title: VLSIDA sky130_sram_macros (README and tree)
supports: Opened via git 2026-11-01: README says 'Currently supported sizes are 1kbytes, 2kbytes and 4kbytes'; a 16kbyte directory holds only a generation log (no LEF/GDS); last commit 2024-07-12
